name: CivilianMale
prompt:
OPAQUE WHITE PAPER BACKGROUND, fully opaque RGB image with solid white #FFFFFF in every empty region, including between limbs. No transparency or alpha channel, gradient, vignette or halo. Use case: stylized-concept. LATTICE production design. Crisp cel-shaded anime game art with restrained flat local-color regions and readable silhouettes. Even unshadowed studio illumination. No gloss, specular highlights, reflections, rim light, cast shadows, ground shadows, ambient occlusion, bloom spill, scenery, floor, particles, text, labels, watermark, borders or detached decorative parts. Emissive lines are opaque saturated color, not illumination. Every appendage is visibly rooted in its body.
Exactly ONE isolated complete subject, ONE view only, filling 80-88 percent of the canvas with clear margin on every side. No inset, turnaround, duplicate, cropped appendage or ground plane. This image will be reconstructed into 3D.
Vael alien anatomy: smooth matte slate skin and a lighter face/throat/palms, plantigrade biped, no tail, no external ears, no hair, no fur or scales. Swept-back elongated cranium, low sensory ridge behind jaw, soft low-bridge nose, almond eyes with readable pale sclera and ring irises. Crown/back crest consists of thick flat overlapping keratin FRONDS, not hair strands. Branching sync-lines run temple to jaw, collar to sternum, elbow to hand and knee to shin. Four fingers plus thumb per hand; all five separated. Forearm 1.06-1.12 times upper arm. Body 7.2-7.6 heads tall, adult 1.85-1.95m. Natural forms wear muted asymmetric wraps over a fitted underlayer with collar node, two wrist bands and a spine docking plate. Practical trousers stop short of feet: no long skirt bridging legs.
Orrin Malk, mature male dockmaster, broad rectangular face, broad flattened nose, heavy low brow, tired hooded green ring eyes, wide square jaw, closed fond frown. Short cropped stone-grey keratin plumes #7C858D; slate-grey skin #667681, face #98A5AA, restrained dim-green sync-lines #49BE87. Deep navy underlayer #26384A, slate-beige asymmetric dock-office wraps #8C8C7D and one muted green sash #487764. Shoulder width 1.22-1.30 hip width; waist 0.90-0.98 hip width. Clearly older, broader and more grounded than Taren; no beard or human ears.
Single straight orthographic FRONT view, face aimed exactly with torso, calm closed mouth, neutral relaxed A pose: arms 30-40 degrees away from sides, palms forward, five relaxed separated digits with visible white gaps. Feet parallel, shoulder width apart. Unbroken wide white gaps between both arms and trunk, between legs from crotch down, between fingers, and around accessories. Wraps stay on the torso or their own leg and never bridge legs. No held props.
